prompt: A disease affects 1% of a population. A diagnostic test has 99% sensitivity (true positive rate) and 95% specificity (true negative rate). If a random person tests positive, what is the probability they actually have the disease? Give the answer as a decimal.

A radioactive substance has a half-life of 8 years. Starting with 500 grams, how many grams remain after 20 years? Give the answer as a decimal.

In how many distinct ways can 6 people be seated around a circular table, if seatings that are rotations of each other are considered identical?

A fair 6-sided die is rolled 3 times. What is the expected value of the maximum of the three rolls? Give the answer as a decimal.
